meta.title: Join the Roster | Applications for Performers | Take 3 Agency
meta.description: Applications to join Take 3 Agency: dancers, SPACTs, models, stand-ins and specialist performers with professional experience on film, television and commercial sets.
meta.ogDescription: Applications from dancers, SPACTs, models, stand-ins and specialist performers with professional experience.
meta.footerIntro: Every application is made through the artist portal, so please do not email or phone the agency about yours. If you have a question about applying that the portal cannot answer, write to the applications address below.

hero.heading: Join the roster
hero.lede: We represent SPACTs, actors, dancers, models, stunt performers, stand-ins, circus and aerial performers, sports and specialists, intimacy artists and creatives.

figure.alt: A performer in a long black leather coat and patent boots kicks one leg straight up against a deep red backdrop.

disciplines.heading: Who we represent

items.name: SPACT
items.body: Fight scenes, weapons handling and military drills for film and TV. Often booked under crowd.
items.imageAlt: A performer in black tactical kit and body armour carrying a rifle, turning to look over his shoulder.

items.name: Actor
items.body: Scripted roles across film, TV, commercials and theatre.
items.imageAlt: A black-and-white portrait of a long-haired, bearded actor sitting shirtless in dark trousers, looking off to one side.

items.name: Dancer
items.body: Choreographed movement for film, TV, commercials, music videos and live events.
items.imageAlt: A dancer in loose black clothing and boots arched backwards with one leg kicked straight up, photographed in black and white.

items.name: Model
items.body: Featured and crowd roles for film and TV, plus commercial and promotional campaigns.
items.imageAlt: A black-and-white portrait of a model with a fringe resting her cheek on her hand, looking to camera.

items.name: Stunt performer
items.body: Stunts and action sequences for film and TV, for performers with recognised stunt training or a professional stunt career under way.
items.imageAlt: A soldier in full kit thrown to the ground on a smoke-filled street, a building burning behind him.

items.name: Stand-in
items.body: Standing in for principal actors of a similar height and build during camera and lighting setup, including photo, body and picture doubles.
items.imageAlt: A stand-in holds a mark on a darkened stage while the crew set a large overhead soft light around them.

items.name: Intimacy artist
items.body: Intimate, nude or semi-nude scenes for film and TV, with boundaries and consent always agreed in advance.
items.imageAlt: Two performers in a close, choreographed scene.

items.name: Circus & aerial
items.body: Circus, aerial and acrobatic performance for film, TV and stage, including fire performers.
items.imageAlt: A circus performer in a rigged studio space.

items.name: Sports & specialists
items.body: Professional and semi-professional athletes: footballers, BMX riders, skaters, boxers and more.
items.imageAlt: A BMX rider mid-air on his bike, photographed in black and white against a white backdrop.

disciplines.note: Every artist meets the agency in person, at an interview or an audition, before joining.

curated.heading: Everyone on our books, we have met
curated.body: Take 3's books are a carefully curated roster of exceptional talent. Every performer on them has been through our audition or interview process before joining, so we can guarantee productions and our clients high-quality performers we have seen and trust.

items.alt: A performer in black trousers and stilettos balances on one leg with the other kicked high, hand to her face, against a red backdrop.
A performer in white cargo trousers and a red and black jacket caught upside down mid-flip against a red backdrop.
A performer in pinstripe trousers and a mesh vest leaps sideways, jacket flying, against a red backdrop.

prepare.heading: What to have to hand
prepare.intro: The application should take approximately 10–15 minutes to complete. Before you start, please make sure you have the following information and materials to hand:
items: Your current measurements and a measuring tape, in case anything needs checking
A selection of your current professional photographs
Your latest showreel or a link to view it online
prepare.note: Don't worry if you can't complete everything in one go. Your application will save automatically, so you can leave at any point and return to finish it later using the same account.

figure.alt: A performer in a black velvet dress with tattooed arms, hands crossed at the waist, looking straight to camera against a red backdrop.

process.heading: Applying, step by step
process.note: Everyone who joins comes in to meet us, either for an interview with the agency or an in-person audition.

apply.heading: Apply on the artist portal
apply.body: Applications are made through our artist portal. Create an account, fill in your profile and submit it: that is the only route onto the roster, and every application that comes through it is read.
apply.contactNote: Please do not email or phone the agency about your application: all applications must be made through the portal. Questions about applying can go to
